info.title: KiraOrder v1.3 API
info.description: Gate 0 machine contract. Success responses return models directly; errors use Error. Every response carries X-Request-ID. This file defines contracts only, not a business implementation.

post.summary: Parse a masked order message and create draft version 1
post.description: Allowed roles are CLERK and OWNER. The backend performs local PII masking before persistence or logging; raw message_text is request-scoped only.

get.summary: List drafts visible to the current tenant

put.summary: Atomically replace editable lines, resolve message issues and create a version
put.description: Every existing line_id must appear exactly once in lines or deleted_line_ids. The service recalculates issues, prices, clarification, escalation and status.

post.summary: Approve the latest saved version or create an owner approval request

get.summary: List approval work items visible to the current user
get.description: OWNER sees tenant approval work items and may use mine=true to filter to items personally submitted. CLERK is always server-filtered to requested_by=current_user, regardless of the mine value, and receives read-only items with allowed_actions=[]. WAREHOUSE is forbidden.

get.summary: Get immutable approval snapshot and allowed actions
get.description: OWNER may read any approval in the current tenant. CLERK may read only an item whose requested_by equals the current user; other items are returned as 404 and allowed_actions is empty. WAREHOUSE is forbidden.

post.summary: Approve or reject an owner approval request
post.description: OWNER only. REJECT requires a non-empty note.

get.summary: Compare AI initial snapshot with the approved delivery order
Get identity, tenant, role and server-authoritative permissions
Get AI endpoint readiness and current mode

post.description: Allowed roles are CLERK and OWNER.

get.description: P0 customer picker source. WAREHOUSE is forbidden. Phone is role-cropped.
P0 completion/refresh path. Requires CLERK or OWNER; WAREHOUSE must use the warehouse endpoint.

get.summary: Read a role-redacted DO for WAREHOUSE (P1 view binding)
get.description: P1 warehouse read endpoint; response schema has no price, phone, tier, raw message or AI fields.

X-Request-ID.description: Correlation identifier returned on every response.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the request may be retried.

Mine.name: mine
Mine.description: OWNER optional self-submission filter. CLERK is always restricted to self-submitted approvals even when this parameter is omitted or false.

ApprovalRequestResponse.description: Owner approval request created or returned.

ApprovalDetailResponse.description: Approval item with immutable snapshot and diffs.

DecisionResponse.description: APPROVE returns a delivery order; REJECT returns a rejection result.

UnauthorizedError.description: Missing, expired or invalid bearer token.

ForbiddenError.description: Authenticated but action is forbidden or tenant mismatch was supplied.

NotFoundError.description: Resource does not exist in the current tenant view.

ConflictError.description: Resource state or optimistic version conflict.

ValidationError.description: Request shape, field value or required configuration is invalid.

RateLimitedError.description: Parse or AI wake rate limit exceeded.

UnavailableError.description: AI and safe fallback are both unavailable.

CustomerListResponse.description: Customers visible in the current tenant; phone is role-cropped.

WarehouseDeliveryOrderResponse.description: Warehouse-facing DO with price, phone, tier and raw message removed.

family_id.description: Optional on writes when sku_id determines family; responses use UNKNOWN, never null.

source_span.description: Masked source text for display and fallback when offsets are invalid.

candidate_skus.description: Stable candidate list for unresolved/low-confidence lines; empty when the line is already resolved.

saved_alias.description: Alias created by a previous save for this line, so the checkbox can be restored after refresh.

available_qty.description: Inventory for the currently selected sku_id; null when no sku is selected. Distinct from candidate_skus[].available_qty.

condition_id.description: Required for CUSTOMER_CONDITION; null for non-condition issues. Deterministically derived as CND_ plus the first 24 uppercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256(UTF-8(draft_id|condition_kind|span_start|span_end)).

source_span.description: Derived compatibility alias of span; remove after the v1.3 frontend migration.

message_text.description: Raw pasted message. The backend masks PII before logging or persistence.

phone_e164.description: Omitted or null in role-redacted responses.

masked_message.description: Backend-masked message; raw message_text is never returned or persisted.

conditions.description: Derived CUSTOMER_CONDITION subset of issues for direct UI rendering.

do_number.description: DO number when status is DO_GENERATED; null otherwise.
DO number when status is DO_GENERATED; null otherwise.

confirmed_items.description: Compatibility only; atomically save a new version before approving it.

field_path.description: Field path relative to line_id when line_id is present (e.g. unit_price_override); otherwise relative to the draft/DO root. Do not use array indexes.

WarehouseDeliveryOrder.description: Role-redacted WAREHOUSE view; price, tier, phone, raw message and AI fields are forbidden.
